name: Émilie du Châtelet (Marquise du Châtelet)
shortBio: French natural philosopher, mathematician, and physicist; translated and annotated Newton's Principia, establishing the groundbreaking philosophical synthesis of Newtonian empirical mechanics with Leibnizian metaphysics of kinetic energy (mv²) and sufficient reason.
centralQuestion: How can the empirical mathematical mechanics of Newton be reconciled with and metaphysically grounded by the Leibnizian Principle of Sufficient Reason?

keyWorks.title: Institutions de Physique (Foundations of Physics)
keyWorks.description: Foundational textbook integrating Newtonian physics with Leibnizian metaphysics, defending vis viva (living force) as mv².

keyWorks.title: Translation and Commentary on Newton's Principia Mathematica
keyWorks.description: Definitive French translation with extensive mathematical and analytical commentaries, remaining the standard French edition to this day.
